standing_rule: Prose without a failing test always loses to a convenient default.
purpose: Harness-scope epoch-budget extension of typed G_fit on cold SE(3)-lite. Not a coefficient retune. Not biology. Not pool. Resolves whether E=200 INCONCLUSIVE_UNDERFIT was budget-limited or approaching a geometric ceiling below 0.80.

geometric_prior.constant_r_caveat: r12 differs across folds (0.20, 0.29, 0.36) and is estimated from exactly two blocks each. If r is still increasing, the 0.76 binding ceiling is too pessimistic and the discarded linear/integral estimates may be closer. E=400 supplies a third (and fourth) block — that is the test of the assumption, not a footnote.
discarded_as_optimistic: linear extrapolation of late fitted slopes (50–220 ep to threshold)
continuous half-life integral of late dA/10ep slopes
geometric_prior.pre_registered_expectation: PLATEAU_BELOW more likely than CLEARS_0_80. A clear would be a surprise relative to this prior.

pins.metric: last-epoch train-fold pooled dehydron AUPRC (typed inputs)

device_note: CUDA required. E=200 used cpu only because the sealed packet pinned it and tokyoeye_mlflow had no GPU reservation; that was convenience, not a science constraint. Script falls back to cpu only if CUDA unavailable — treat fallback as a STOP and fix GPU passthrough before accepting results.

B2.gain: A@200 - A@100 (use stamped curve point nearest 199/200)

block_definitions.note: Use curve_every_10 points; if exact endpoint missing, nearest logged epoch ≤ target.

read_order_mandatory: 1_r_trajectory — test constant-r assumption BEFORE threshold or plateau labels
4_named_outcome — pick exactly one of outcomes below; no improvised fourth label

r_trajectory_test.purpose: Validate or falsify the constant-r assumption that produced the 0.76 ceiling.
r_trajectory_test.if_R_CLIMBING: Geometric ceiling prior was too pessimistic. Recompute ceiling with three+ blocks before any capacity/pool read. Distinct finding from AUPRC vs 0.80.

plateau_test.purpose: Numeric definition of plateau — escalation must not be a post-hoc judgment call.
plateau_test.fraction_rationale: Prior r12 band was 0.20–0.36. Fraction 0.50 is a noise-tolerant upper bound for 'decay holding' on 100-ep blocks; tighter than 'still gaining at similar or increasing rate.'
plateau_test.card_plateau_confirmed_if: every fold with A@400 < 0.80 satisfies per_fold_plateau_if

CLEARS_0_80.if: all three folds A@400 >= 0.80 AND G_finite
CLEARS_0_80.means: Typed fit reachable on this lite rig given more budget. Arm B S1/S2 failure becomes interpretable → FAIL_NO_SIGNAL branch.
CLEARS_0_80.next: Stamp FAIL_NO_SIGNAL path on disposition. Do not escalate to pool for capacity. Do not retune.

PLATEAU_BELOW.if: G_finite AND not CLEARS_0_80 AND card R_STABLE AND plateau_confirmed
PLATEAU_BELOW.means: Constant-r held; remaining gain exhausted below threshold. SE(3)-lite harness is capacity-limited for typed dehydron fit.
PLATEAU_BELOW.next: Escalate to Equiformer-pool G_fit as capacity probe (harness frontend change, not coeff retune). Do not keep extending lite epochs.

DECAY_UNSETTLED.if: G_finite AND not CLEARS_0_80 AND (card R_CLIMBING OR not plateau_confirmed)
DECAY_UNSETTLED.means: Still below 0.80 but decay model failed or gains not yet decaying — neither 'on track to clear with more lite epochs' as a free pass nor 'capacity-limited, escalate to pool'.
DECAY_UNSETTLED.next: STOP. Do not auto-escalate to pool. Do not silently bump epochs again. Re-estimate ceiling from ≥3 blocks; new pre-reg required for any further lite extend or pool step.
DECAY_UNSETTLED.prior_odds: the outcome the binary gate previously could not name
